INSERT INTO calendar_events (
            id, owner_id, source_link_id, ical_uid, title,
            starts_at, ends_at, canonical_source_kind,
            updated_at
        )
        VALUES (
            $1, $2, $3, 'edited@example.com', 'Edited event',
            now(), now() + interval '1 hour', 'google',
            now() - interval '1 day'
        )
